title: RAMP WBAFile (Web Bot Auth directory)
description: Pure Web Bot Auth directory served at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory. An RFC 7517 JWK Set (keys) plus an optional directory-level revocation_url, with zero RAMP-specific fields. Wire shape is protojson of ramp.v1.WBAFile with UseProtoNames=true (snake_case fields).

keys.$comment: Upper bound complements the 64 KiB body cap: a directory holds only a handful of keys (rotation overlaps a few), so a large keys[] is malformed. Bounds parse/thumbprint work by entry count, not just bytes.
